confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Yogyakarta and Indonesian tourist pricing; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weak, and beer carries uncertainty from Indonesia's high alcohol taxes and wide venue variation. Hotel rates vary by district and season, and July often overlaps Indonesian school holidays, so accommodation values could be off in either direction. USD figures reflect approximate mid-2026 rupiah levels and will shift with currency moves.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional judgment rather than a sourced comparison: benchmarked against Java's other heritage-tourism cities (such as Solo and Malang) and mainland Southeast Asian backpacker hubs with similar hostel and guesthouse supply, with alcohol set higher relative to food to reflect Indonesian excise taxes.
